preview: This episode explores why silence can become uncomfortable and why researchers do not treat every quiet moment in the same way. The studies look at silence in conversations and when people are alone. By the end, you will have a clearer way to think about what a silent moment may mean.
comment_1: Listen for what happens to people’s feelings when a conversation suddenly becomes quiet.
comment_2: A pause may feel rejecting in one situation but comfortable in another. What can make silence calming rather than uncomfortable?
comment_3: The main idea is that silence is not always good or bad. Its effect can change with the situation and with the people involved. Now, let’s look at two more ways to understand why people react to quiet differently.
comment_4: So far, we have seen that silence can feel different when people can choose how to use it, and that the setting matters when people from different countries are compared. Now, let’s bring these ideas together and hear the main message.
